**Finding: compliant (at fallback).**

- **Governing law (§ 15.9):** Delaware law — the playbook fallback, not the preferred New York. Acceptable, no redline.
- **Forum (§ 15.10, 15.10.2.2):** Executive Officer escalation, then final and binding ICDR arbitration, **seated in New York** and governed by the Federal Arbitration Act. No foreign seat, no exclusive venue in SFJ's home jurisdiction, so the walk-away trigger (mandatory arbitration seated abroad / foreign venue) is not engaged.
- **Carve-outs preserved:** IP ownership/validity disputes go to a U.S. federal court; either Party may seek preliminary injunctive relief in any court of competent jurisdiction.

Shortfalls versus preferred (Delaware rather than New York law; domestic arbitration rather than New York County courts) are noted in the rationale only — they are not material fallback failures, so no redline was proposed.
